snippet.title: The Ghost of Solaris - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist 'The Ghost of Solaris' on Steam now: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4452300/The_Ghost_Of_Solaris/

Welcome to the Silver District. Watch the official announcement trailer for The Ghost of Solaris, an intense, high-octane action shooter built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5.

Survive the City of Ghosts. Play as Zain and navigate a dark, unforgiving sci-fi world where every shadow hides a new threat.

Key Features:

Next-Gen Visuals: Experience breathtaking, realistic lighting and environments powered by Unreal Engine 5's Lumen technology.

Unforgiving Combat: Fast-paced, tactical gunplay that will test your reflexes and strategy.

Immersive World: Explore the atmospheric, heavily guarded sectors of the Silver District.

🔔 Subscribe to this channel for more development updates and gameplay reveals: https://youtube.com/@TheGhostOfSolaris?si=kFcFZ9R6ycqdjcnb

Follow Us:

Official Website: https://www.mrsaqlainproductions.site/

Steam Publisher Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4452300/The_Ghost_Of_Solaris/?beta=1

Tiktok : https://www.tiktok.com/@theghostofsolaris

Developed by MSP Universe and Published by MR SAQLAIN PRODUCTIONS.
